import asyncio
from typing import Awaitable, Callable, Sequence, TypeVar

T = TypeVar("T")


# CASE py_canonical expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE py_typed_docstring expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency_typed(
    items: Sequence[T], width: int, operation: Callable[[T], Awaitable[None]]
) -> None:
    """Run operation on items, at most width at a time."""
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE py_comment_in_body expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency_c(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        # Await one chunk at a time.
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE py_method expect=pass
class Pool:
    async def map_with_concurrency(self, items, width, operation):
        for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
            await asyncio.gather(
                *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
            )


# CASE py_impostor_serial_inner expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency_bad(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        for item in items[offset : offset + width]:
            await operation(item)


# CASE py_in_order_canonical expect=pass
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        await step(item)
